summary: Partial frontend testing completed for 4 new features (Warehouse Learning, Catalog from Master, Fulfillment Monitoring, Weekly Reports). Successfully verified Fulfillment Monitoring module loads with correct data. Testing blocked by critical session expiration issue preventing navigation between modules.

integration_issues.issue: Session expires immediately when navigating between modules using deep links (e.g., ?portal=toko&module=marketing-fulfillment). User is redirected to login page after successful login when accessing module URLs directly.
integration_issues.impact: Blocks all frontend testing - cannot navigate between modules to test features
integration_issues.reproduction: 1. Login successfully 2. Navigate to any module URL (e.g., /?portal=toko&module=marketing-fulfillment) 3. Session expires and redirects to login
integration_issues.notes: This appears to be a frontend session/token management issue. Backend is proven working (51/51 tests pass). Likely related to token storage, expiration handling, or route guards.
